Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  13 = 1 * 3
  20 = 2 * 0
  22 = 2 * 2
  30 = 3 * 0
  32 = 3 * 2
  33 = 3 * 3
  011 = 0 * 11
  013 = 0 * 13
  222 = 2 * 22
  1210 = 12 * 10
  2030 = 20 * 30
  3230 = 32 * 30
  3311 = 33 * 11
  00011 = 00 * 011
  0001132 = 00011 * 32
  0133311 = 013 * 3311
  1210222 = 1210 * 222
  32302030 = 3230 * 2030
